# Xellence AI

> Xellence AI enables private, on-premises AI for small and mid-sized businesses and puts it to work on everyday tasks: answering customers, handling documents, preparing quotes and reports, and finding information fast. Customer data stays on the customer's own equipment, costs stay predictable (no per-seat fees), and no in-house AI team is needed.

Xellence AI is the trade name of Xellence Solutions LLC. Owner: Jeffrey Chang. Headquartered in North America. Contact: hello@xellence.ai

Xellence AI solutions are powered by Nurol AI's private AI products, NurOS™ and NuroMAX™, which the Xellence AI team sets up and integrates for each client.

## Who it's for

Small and mid-sized business owners who want the benefits of AI without an enterprise budget or the risk of sending company data to public AI services.

## Results

- [Output per person](https://xellence.ai/#results): drafting, summarizing, and routine answers take minutes, not hours.
- [Speed to customers](https://xellence.ai/#results): quotes and replies go out the same day, drafted from the business's own materials.
- [Company know-how](https://xellence.ai/#results): manuals, contracts, and past projects answer questions on the spot.
- [Value per dollar](https://xellence.ai/#results): one system serves the whole team, with no fee for each new hire.

Goals (for example hours saved or response time) are agreed before work starts and measured on the customer's own work.

## Why on-premises

- [Comparison with public AI subscriptions](https://xellence.ai/#on-prem): data stays on the premises instead of outside servers; a system the customer owns instead of per-user fees; access set by the business with every use logged; connected privately to company documents and systems; keeps working during internet outages; free choice of AI models. Routine, non-sensitive tasks can still use cloud AI under the customer's rules.

## What we deliver

- [AI Opportunity Assessment](https://xellence.ai/#solutions): finds where AI saves the most, with a clear plan and a fixed quote.
- [Private AI, On Your Premises](https://xellence.ai/#solutions): a system sized for the team, ready to use from day one.
- [AI Assistants for Your Work](https://xellence.ai/#solutions): customer service, quotes, document review, and reporting, all drawing on the business's own documents.
- [Connected to Your Tools](https://xellence.ai/#solutions): email, files, CRM, ERP, and accounting.
- [Security & Access Control](https://xellence.ai/#solutions): company sign-in, role-based permissions, and a record of every use.
- [Training & Support](https://xellence.ai/#solutions): hands-on training, ongoing support, and new uses over time.

## Powered by

- [NurOS™](https://nurol.ai): the private AI platform from Nurol AI. Runs AI models on the customer's own hardware, under the customer's rules.
- [NuroMAX™](https://nurol.ai): no-code AI agents from Nurol AI for IT operations, help desk, reporting, and more.

## How it works

1. Talk: an open conversation about the business's goals and where the team's time goes.
2. Plan: choose the first tasks, size the system, and provide a fixed quote.
3. Set up: we set up and test everything on-site, then train the team.
4. Grow: review results together and add new uses when the business is ready.

## Values

Collaboration · Quality · The Future.

- Collaboration: we learn how a business works before we recommend anything.
- Quality: every system is tested and measured against goals set together.
- The Future: we adopt new AI when it earns its place, not because it's the latest trend.

Backed by 20+ years in systems integration, industrial IoT, networking, cloud and web, and data security.
